product_consequence: Closes the direction and scale of the Netherlands national-route demand proxy while showing a 46.9 percent decline from 2022 to 2025
safe_interim_behavior: Use as corridor activity and trend evidence only; never equate arrivals with TAM

claim: CBS reports approximately 14,000 non-EU knowledge migrants arriving in 2025 and states the count had approximately halved from 26,000 in 2022
contradiction_status: Rounded news figures corroborate the detailed table but do not identify technology occupations or acquisition reach
product_consequence: Provides an independent official narrative check on the detailed series and weakens any growth-based Netherlands thesis
safe_interim_behavior: Retain Netherlands for sponsor-verification wedge not because of assumed volume growth

claim: IAPMEI publishes a Tech Visa certified-company list containing corporate tax number legal name certification date and expiration date and separately provides access-code validation for the mandatory employer responsibility term
contradiction_status: The index page can show an older timestamp while the linked downloadable list is newer and expired rows may remain visible
product_consequence: Creates authoritative company identity and time-bounded certification evidence plus a job-specific responsibility-term validation primitive
safe_interim_behavior: Match by NIF and legal name; require certification validity at decision date; never infer an unvalidated responsibility term

claim: Consolidated Law of 29 August 2008 article 45 requires high professional qualifications, a valid highly qualified contract and salary at least the amount fixed by Grand-Ducal regulation
contradiction_status: The exact current Grand-Ducal amount regulation remains unresolved
product_consequence: Anchors legal predicates while keeping the mutable numeric instrument separate
safe_interim_behavior: Do not treat the administrative EUR 65,652 figure as self-proving statutory provenance

claim: Current Aliens Act section 42j requires a highly qualified contract or future contract for at least six months at statutory weekly hours and gross pay of at least 1.5 times the annually announced average gross annual wage
contradiction_status: Older ministry material still states a one-year contract
product_consequence: Resolves current law in favour of six months and identifies stale administrative content
safe_interim_behavior: Use current statutory duration; show conflict warning where stale page is surfaced

claim: MPSV announcement 44/2026 sets the reference average at CZK 590,580 annually for 1 May 2026 through 30 April 2027; applying the statutory 1.5 multiplier yields CZK 885,870 annually or CZK 73,822.50 monthly
product_consequence: Closes the current numeric chain and supplies exact effective dates
safe_interim_behavior: Store reference and derived threshold separately; replay across 1 May

claim: The Migration Department published 2026 BDU of EUR 2,411.40 and exact multiples of EUR 2,893.68 at 1.2 and EUR 3,617.10 at 1.5 for applications accepted from 12 May 2026
contradiction_status: Pre-12-May intermediary letters enter a transition workflow and post-25-May stale letters are returned for correction
product_consequence: Closes the 2026 numeric successor and creates a cohort boundary
safe_interim_behavior: Version by acceptance/intermediary-letter date and retain transition state

claim: EU Member States issued 78,096 EU Blue Cards in 2024, down 12.3 percent from 89,055 in 2023 after 81,846 in 2022
contradiction_status: Eurostat says the 2024 fall was probably related to directive revision; this is not causal proof of demand decline
product_consequence: Prevents one-year issuance from being treated as a stable growth rate
safe_interim_behavior: Use multi-year scenarios and do not claim market growth from this series

claim: Germany, Poland, Hungary, France and Spain accounted for 89.5 percent of 2024 EU Blue Cards; Germany alone issued 56,252 or 72.0 percent
product_consequence: Revealed Blue Card demand is highly concentrated and argues against simultaneous equal-depth launch across Europe
safe_interim_behavior: Fund Germany depth first and treat expansion as evidence-gated

claim: Indian citizens received 16,300 EU Blue Cards in 2024 or 21 percent of the EU total
product_consequence: Supports India as a corridor-research hypothesis but does not establish reachable paying demand
safe_interim_behavior: Run origin-specific acquisition and willingness-to-pay tests before allocating growth spend

claim: Eurostat's Blue Card statistical unit is people covered by administrative procedures and a person can be counted more than once where different procedures or multiple cards occur in a year
product_consequence: Permit counts are not unique customers and cannot directly equal TAM
safe_interim_behavior: Apply a documented unique-person and reachable-user adjustment before revenue sizing

claim: Portaria 480-A/2025 sets the 2026 IAS at EUR 537.13 from 1 January 2026 and expressly revokes Portaria 6-B/2025; the Tech Visa 2.5-IAS floor therefore derives to EUR 1,342.825 before the route's required rounding treatment
contradiction_status: The Tech Visa source must confirm whether and how the derived cent fraction is rounded
product_consequence: Closes IAS provenance and predecessor supersession while preserving a rounding review
safe_interim_behavior: Store IAS and multiplier separately; no exact-boundary pass until rounding is confirmed

claim: Walloon Government Decree of 6 June 2024 article 25 requires an indefinite or at least six-month employment instrument, an annually adjusted salary floor, higher qualifications, and allows three relevant years in seven for ICT managers or specialists
contradiction_status: Displayed historical amount must be combined with the current annual adjustment rather than treated as static
product_consequence: Anchors the Walloon branch and ICT-experience exception in regional law
safe_interim_behavior: Compile current adjusted amount separately and require region evidence

claim: Brussels Government Decree of 16 May 2024 article 22 requires an indefinite or at least six-month contract, salary at least 100 percent of Brussels average gross monthly pay, and higher qualifications or the three-in-seven ICT experience branch
contradiction_status: Exact canonical eJustice retrieval and current consolidation remain to be captured
product_consequence: Anchors the Brussels formula and qualification branches but is not canonical-source complete
safe_interim_behavior: Use current regional administrative amount and retain legal-source-review flag

claim: S.I. 643/2025 commenced its remuneration amendments on 1 March 2026 and sets Schedule 8 Critical Skills values at EUR 40,904 for the standard listed-occupation branches and EUR 36,848 for a qualifying Level-8-or-higher award obtained within the prior 12 months; it also substitutes EUR 68,911 for the prior EUR 64,000 high-pay figure
product_consequence: Resolves the official-page discrepancy by source precedence and separates standard graduate and high-pay branches
safe_interim_behavior: Use statutory values and effective date; retain conflicting DETE table as monitored defect

claim: The government migrant-integration portal describes the ISTAT annual average gross remuneration floor as approximately EUR 36,300 and separately requires salary not below the applicable national collective agreement
contradiction_status: The linked ISTAT table observation and publication vintage are not exposed in a stable cited snapshot; approximately is not an exact boundary
product_consequence: Narrows the scale but confirms the legal test is max of two independent floors
safe_interim_behavior: Never use EUR 36,300 for exact pass/fail; require exact ISTAT observation and applicable CCNL

claim: The Labour Ministry states Italy has no single statutory minimum wage applicable across all workers and that national collective bargaining agreements are central to determining sufficient and proportionate pay by the employer's economic category
contradiction_status: Selecting the applicable agreement and level remains employer/job-specific
product_consequence: Confirms that a single Italy salary threshold would be structurally unsafe
safe_interim_behavior: Require employer sector CCNL identifier level and current pay table or return review_required

claim: Fragomen markets immigration technology spanning case initiation documents status and knowledge products across more than 170 jurisdictions and states that its knowledge group maintains 50000 research data points across 130 countries
contradiction_status: Scale and corpus figures are vendor claims and do not establish accuracy or outcomes
product_consequence: Demonstrates that breadth expert operations and structured knowledge are incumbent capabilities rather than an AutoTime moat
safe_interim_behavior: Do not claim defensibility from country count citations or an expert network alone

claim: Envoy markets pre-hire eligibility assessment with legal guidance case and document management HRIS connections spend forecasting AI validation and direct legal-team access
contradiction_status: Capability descriptions are vendor claims and the workflow is employer-side
product_consequence: Shows that eligibility screening connected to counsel is an established competitive bundle
safe_interim_behavior: Differentiate only where candidate control vacancy specificity independence and measured longitudinal utility are demonstrated
